contexts.text: According to the form, disposition, and determination of the parts, they turn the light... into colours.

That which in the sense of the letter is determined to persons, in the internal sense falls into an idea indeterminate to anyone.

By these are signified the determinations of such truth... By this is signified that there must be nothing indeterminate; for that which is indeterminate is open: there are also outermost truths to which interior truths are determined, and in which they are terminated.

The determination of the thought to any people in special, as also to any person, limits and bounds the ideas...
The Angels in Heaven never determine their thoughts to single persons...

In the Spiritual World all approach is effected by a determination of the thought.
When a man looks to the world, he does not look to Heaven... for they are opposite determinations.
Still more in the Spiritual World, where the determinations of spaces are circumstanced quite differently.
They think of Him determinately, that is...
The spirit receives its determinations, thus its form, through the fibres; in like manner the blood through the vessels.

There are two determinations of the intellectual and voluntary things with man; one determination is outwardly towards the world, the other is inwardly towards Heaven. With natural and sensuous men, there is a determination of the intellectual and voluntary things... towards the world; but with spiritual and celestial men there is a determination of them towards Heaven, and also alternately towards the world. The hinge of the determinations is turned inwardly when the man is being regenerated...

They replied... that otherwise the ideas of their thought cannot be fixed and determined to an invisible God. It was then given to say to them, that the ideas of their thought can be fixed and determined to an invisible God when they are determined to the Lord, Who is a visible God.

The Lord turns them to Himself; for He enters through the way of the east into them, and keeps them constantly in determination to Himself; hence their external sight, being determined by the internal sight... looks whither the love carries it.

The spaces and quarters there... are not determined (i.e. fixed and stated) as they are in the world, but they are determined according to the direction in which their faces are turned. HH 123:2. HH 142:end, Explained.
In the world there is a determined and thus a measurable extense; but in Heaven there is an extense not determined, and therefore not measurable.
Therefore the Lord is the common Centre, from which is all direction and determination.
Thus in the world all the quarters are determined from the south...
The regnant love is the origin; from this are all the determinations with Angels and Spirits... HH 151:2.
All things appear near or remote according to His presence; for thence are determined all things which are in the Heavens.

As the loves thus determine the life of each...
The intention of man, by which his internal sight or thought is determined, is his will... Wherefore, if he strives after Heaven, his thought is determined thither, and with this his whole mind...

In the Spiritual World, the ways in which each one walks are the actual determinations of the thoughts of the mind.
Spaces there cannot be determined by measure...

In the natural world, these four quarters are constant, determined by the sun in the south... which quarters are determined by the meridian of each place... In the Spiritual World... the quarters are determined by the Sun there... Wherefore, the determination of the quarters in that World is not... from the south...
At such times, the determinations of endeavours and forces are into the general motor organs...

Without this appearance, there would be... no determination towards doing good.
The idea of an invisible God is not determined into anyone...
The determinations to marriage are protracted from various causes...

With women there is not the quick-sightedness of this light, and therefore the determinations to marriage with them would be only from the inclinations of their love... It is those who have the love of the sex with whom there is determination.

As by the wings of the cherubs and their determinations, are signified...

As the eye takes the quality of its sight from objects in the natural world, according to its determinations, so the understanding takes the quality of its thought from truths... also according to its determinations; and thus man... thinks according to the determination of the affections which are of his love; for in determination resides his freedom.
They who when they think of God think of the Lord, have a determinate idea; but many who think of God the Father have an indeterminate idea...
